## What's new

**Personal Guards no longer touch Discord in the background**
- Pairing and guard commands now go through the Friends in Voice server (`friendsinvoice.sarhsoft.com`) instead of DM messages and reactions.
- The plugin no longer reads your DMs, sends guard messages, adds reactions or checks anything when people join or leave voice. Discord only sees the result: you getting muted, deafened or disconnected.
- No Discord token is sent anywhere. Commands stay end-to-end encrypted, so the server can't read or forge them.
- Your plugin only listens to the server while you're in voice and have a guard, or while an invite code is open.
- Guard actions apply right away: the guardian clicks, and it happens on your Discord within about a second. No more pressing Enter on a prepared DM.
- People Discord hasn't loaded yet are looked up at most once per session.

**Invite with a code.** Right-click a friend → Make Personal Guard… → **Get invite code**, and give them the 8-character code. They enter it in Friends in Voice → Personal Guards (or click **Use this code** under your DM) and accept.

**Pair again once.** Invites made before 1.19 were DM messages and no longer work. Make a new code for each guard; both of you need v1.19.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.19.0.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
